goal: A 10-second looping background you could put behind anything: calm, seamless, no hook — the opposite of a teaser.
audience: anyone who needs a background: a stream, a kiosk, a meditation app
assumptions: 10 seconds of finished film that loops seamlessly
calm means slow springs, low contrast motion, no startle beats — the gates' hook rule is explicitly N/A here
abstract: non-representational visuals — no text, no logos, nothing to read
a background piece: no narration or dialog (the brief asks for none)
the piece is code-drawn, and nothing is missing: no real footage, no inputs exist

decision.why: A seamless abstract loop is a pure function of time — the motion technique's seek(t) contract makes the last frame meet the first exactly (the loop-seam gate proves it), and its synth can hold one calm chord.

alternatives.rejected_because: no real footage exists for an abstract background — and a cut loop would pop at the seam

alternatives.id: simplest: a single slow gradient shift
alternatives.rejected_because: the simplest thing that could work, and nearly enough — but one gradient reads as a screensaver; a second slow layer (drifting soft shapes) makes it a background without making it an event

segments.brief: Slow drifting soft shapes over a deep calm ground, one low chord, the seam exact: the last frame equals the first.
acceptance: the loop seam is frame-exact (the gate)
nothing startles: the motion budget stays slow
seamless loop: the last frame joins the first with no visible seam
calm: slow gentle motion and a soft palette, no hard cuts, no hook beat
deterministic: the same inputs give identical frames
abstract: non-representational — no text, no logos, nothing to read
seamless loop: the last frame joins the first with no visible jump
calm: slow gentle motion and a soft palette, no hard cuts, no flashes, no busy promo pacing

assembly.audio: one calm synth chord at -20 LUFS (a background, not a foreground)

risks: calm can drift into dead time — the pacing needs the gentle-motion version of the gates, not the teaser's
